metal_framework.geometry_basis: Shared oxygen in CIF bond table (identity symmetry only); M-O vectors use nearest periodic images, M-M separations use the same bridge images, and the metal-site shape uses bridge-connected unwrapped coordinates. M-M values are separations, not metal-metal bonds.

description: LEBSOB crystallizes in the monoclinic crystal system with space group P 21/n. Reported CIF formula moiety: H18 O125 P4 W30 Yb6 14-,8(C2 H8 N1 1+),6(H4 N1 1+),34(H2 O1). From the CIF bond table, W1 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W2 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W3 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W4 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W5 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W6 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W7 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W8 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W9 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W10 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W11 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W12 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W13 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W14 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W15 (W) has 6 O neighbors; Yb1 (Yb) has 8 O neighbors; Yb2 (Yb) has 8 O neighbors; Yb3 (Yb) has 8 O neighbors; W1B (W) has 6 O neighbors; W2B (W) has 6 O neighbors; W3B (W) has 6 O neighbors; W4B (W) has 6 O neighbors; W5B (W) has 6 O neighbors; W6B (W) has 6 O neighbors; W7B (W) has 6 O neighbors; W8B (W) has 6 O neighbors; W9B (W) has 6 O neighbors; W10B (W) has 6 O neighbors; W11B (W) has 6 O neighbors; W12B (W) has 6 O neighbors; W13B (W) has 6 O neighbors; W14B (W) has 6 O neighbors; W15B (W) has 6 O neighbors; Yb1B (Yb) has 8 O neighbors; Yb2B (Yb) has 8 O neighbors; Yb3B (Yb) has 8 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 81 pairs, 1 components; largest component is a network with cycles with three-dimensional metal-site arrangement. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.336-4.975 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 88.80-180.00°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula [Yb6(μ6-O)(μ3-OH)6(H2O)6(α-P2W15O56)2]14−. Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 1 μ6-O (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 6 μ3-OH (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 6 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article formula). Article name explicitly identifies I(II).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.
